title.en: Spotlight tour over a setup form
title.zh: 在设置表单上的引导式漫游

description.en: Steps anchor to real elements; the overlay starts closed and opens on demand.
description.zh: 各步骤锚定真实元素；遮罩默认关闭，按需打开。

description.en: onOpenChange owns the open state and onFinish gates whether the tour can reopen.
description.zh: 由 onOpenChange 掌握开关，onFinish 决定漫游是否还能再次打开。
